content.text: AdvertisementAdvertisementAdvertisementAdvertisementTRENDINGYankees shut out GiantsJudge's golden sombreroSign up for fantasy baseballOpening day starting pitchersSweet 16 previewPowered by📋 São Paulo line-up to face Chapecoense in the BrasileirãoOneFootballThu, Mar 12, 2026·1 min readAdd Yahoo Sports on GoogleSão Paulo and Chapecoense are set for the clash this Thursday (12) in the Brasileirão.The match for the fifth round of the championship takes place at the Canindé stadium and marks Roger Machado's debut as the coach of Tricolor.AdvertisementAdvertisementAdvertisementBoth teams enter the field still undefeated after four games played.However, São Paulo has three victories, while Chape has only one.Check out the starting line-ups below:São PauloRoger Machado doesn't bring major changes in his first line-up as São Paulo's coach.Lucas, Luciano, and Calleri form the offensive sector of Tricolor.ChapecoenseDefender and captain Bruno Leonardo returns to the starting team after serving a suspension in the final of the Campeonato Catarinense.The offensive sector remains the same as in the state championship decision, with Neto Pessoa, Italo, Giovanni Augusto, and Rafael Carvalheira.This article was translated into English by Artificial Intelligence.
